subtitle.default: Sign in once with the account an admin made, then allow the family VPN.
subtitle.windows: Sign in once with the account an admin made, and the family VPN turns on.

steps.say: Temperance first asks whose {{device}} this is.
This is Riley's, so it installs the family VPN that carries the family's rules.
Riley signs in with the username and password an admin created on the family dashboard.
Riley's profile comes from the account, so there is nothing else to choose. The password isn't kept on the {{device}}.

say.default: One last step: allow the VPN connection.
say.android: One last step: Android asks whether Temperance may set up a VPN.
say.windows: On a PC there's no extra step: signing in turned the family VPN on.

steps.say: That's it. Riley is online, the family's filters are on, and today's two hours of screen time are counting.
Riley never needs to open Temperance again, but it's always here to check.
